data: Deterministic synthetic intents with programmatic ground truth; no teacher model.
separation: Disjoint exact semantic families and request templates; shared vocabulary and generator. Not an external blind test. Historical AC cases excluded from training.

training.targets: text attention q_proj,v_proj only; original head and embeddings frozen
training.loss: 0.5 mean CE on active fields + 0.5 mean CE on omit fields, per whole task
training.selection: Highest dev exact-task accuracy, then fewest extra+missing commands, then earlier checkpoint

validation: Dev labels used for checkpoint selection. Held-out and historical reference labels stay local.
evaluation: Untuned vs selected LoRA, 192 new queries and 78 historical queries, original/reversed options. Original 20 spec queries x3, full30 and serial30 HTTP calls; single-step from actual serial calls. Fresh reload and merged-weight check before timing.
adoption: Held-out exact accuracy must improve, active-field accuracy and historical spec exact accuracy must not decline; zero interface errors; mean and p95 full-task latency within 10% of baseline.
ec2: Existing us-east-1d L4; keep running; no production deployment.
